translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Rpibz Pol “Nimu la,” Mz Kzdung Lr Rom
Fibi kc tqrtwzbz letz lc bamu, nide inwegu kc tqwztrpz mz lrmakxtr kc mz taon Kenkrae, mz nzngini-krde kzdq kxaclvele dalr makxtr. Abrtzlvzx nide murde nide olvz kxmrlz-esz'ngr.
Rlxtibo bamu nzaodu-krmu nide naesz' mz nzngini-krmu leplz neng Gct, murde wztrpz mz Kxetu. Okatramu nide mz nikeng suti drtwrde, murde okatr-zlwzle ninge x leplz kxnzkqlu.

Rpibzmu kx, “Nimu la,” mz kztengeng amrlx mrla, myapxbz Prisila x Akwila, nidr kx wztrpzkr badr mz Jiszs Kxnzmcpx, badr lrmakxtr kcng tzangio-lxblrng ma nyzdr. Ycpwz pipz nzbz-krdr mz nzarlapx-krdr ninge. X nigr badr lrmakxtr amrlx kcng trngiulrJiu awitx-zlwz-ngrbzkr mz Gct nidr.
X kztenge Epenetzs. Nide kx lxngiti-kaile Kraes mz provins kc Esia.
Mxri kc tqwz zlwz mz nzokatr-krde nimu.
Adronikzs x Junia, ni-kzdr lr Jiu. Mrlx lcng nzling mncpxmgr badr mz presin, x nidr aposol kxnzamatqng. Nidr rlilrdr kx nzlxngiti-kailr Kraes x ninge kc ate.
X Ampliatzs, nide mzlenge kx mrlzvxi mz Kxetu.
Urbanzs, nide ncblo kx wzku badr mz nrlarde nyz Kraes. X mrlx kztenge Stakis.
Apelis kc tqaelwapx-ngrde nzpqkr nzlxngiti-krde Kraes, mz nztu-amqngi-krde mz mzlir nzkxpungr. X lr ma nyz Aristobulzs.
X Herodion, ni-kzde lr Jiu. X kxnzrlxngiting kcng tzmncng ma nyz Narsiszs.
Trifaena ncdr Trifosa, olvz kx nzwz-zlwzng mz nrlarde nyz Kxetu. X inwegu Persis kxnzmrlzti. Nide kzdq kz olvz kx wz kato mz nrlarde nyz Kxetu.
X Rufzs, ncblo kxmyapxbz, x lxede kz kc tqapusr-ngrde ninge mrlxde.
Asinkritzs, Flegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas x lrmakxtr amrlx kcng tzangio-lxblrng badr.
X Filologzs, Julia, Olimpas x Nerezs ncdr inwede, x leplz neng Gct amrlx kcng tzangio-lxblrng badr.
Eu, x rpi-etramu, “Nim la,” x male-lxblramu mqmu mz nivz. Lrmakxtr amrlx kcng tzmncng mrka nzrpibzlr bamu kx, “Nimu la.”
Natq Ngr Nzarlr-lzbqngr

Mzlengeng x inwengeng, xplrmibz natqnge bamu, kx aclvetioamu leplz kcng tzakipxlr kxnzrlxngiting. Murde nzatrkatilr nzrlxngiti-krmu mz nzrpi-krbzlr da kx blepxngr mz nzalvztrngr kc tqkrlz-kaiamu. Kapx-lzbqmamu badr.

Murde leplz kxnzmulr lcng trnzwztrpwzung mz Kraes, Kxetu rgu. A' nzvz-nqblq-txpwzlr alwx kznikeng nzaoti drtwrdr kx namrlzbz badr. Nztamiti-krdr leplz mz natq x nzalvztr-krbzlr badr da kxmrlz mz nzxlr-ngrbz, a' nzkrlzlr nzesabrtingr leplz kx trnzaclvetio-lzbqung mz nzalvztr-rbr-krdr lc.
Leplz kxkqlu nzxlrpelr kx vz-nqblqpeamu Nrpakxmrlz. X mz nzmu-krde lcde, abrtztx-zlwz-ngrne nimu. A' suti drtwrnge nakrlz-angidramu da kxmrlz, x bzkq aoti drtwrmu da kxtrka.

Murde ycpe pipz Gct kc tqngi nou nzmnc-zpwxngr, nzodati-krde zmatq ngr Setzn, mz nzokatr-krde nzaovxio-krmu leplz kcng tzrpilr na-akipxlr nimu. Krka'-ngrne kx Kxetu rgu Jiszs Kxnzmcpx naokatr-zvzle nimu mz zmrlz ngrde kxmyalz. Eu, angida.
Kzdung lrmakxtr kcng mrka nzrpi-kzpzlr bamu, “Nimu la.” Kzdung nidr seleng, Timoti kc tqwzkr ncdr. X Lusias, Jeszn x Sospata, mrlx lcng nigr badr lr Jiu.
X Tertizs kc tqyrbzle natqnge lcng.
Gaizs kc tqmnckr ncdr ma nyzde, x kc tqrlr-ngrbzle mz lrmakxtr nzangio-krdr mrka. X wai-kzle Erastzs kc tqaclvele trau ngr taon ka, x mzlegu Kwartzs.
Nzrglqlzkr Pol Gct

content.text: A' mzli ka sc tqaelwapxpengr Gct
Kxmule-esz' nidr lr Jiu o trtingr.
Gct kc tqlu zvz kapxle natq
X nigu kcng tzaxvctrpzng mz Kraes

content: Delape. Ninge Pol.

footnotes.text: Nzrpilr kx Junia ngi drtq olvz, kc tqngi kx aposol.

Ngalrde kc 24 yclzm mz kzdung nzryrngr kcng pnz. X mule narsakrlrmi ngalrde kc 20, mz nzrpi-krde kx, “Eu, krka'-zvz-ngrne kx Kxetu rgu Jiszs Kxnzmcpx naokatrle nimu amrlx ngrmu mz zmrlz ngrde kxmyalz. Eu, angida.”
